1: /**
2:  * Single source of truth for filesystem paths the dashboard touches at runtime.
3:  *
4:  * Why this file exists
5:  * --------------------
6:  * Two distinct directories were historically conflated by `~/`-anchored
7:  * `path.join` calls scattered across packages:
8:  *
9:  *   ~/.pi/dashboard/   — config + the *server* log (`server.log`)
10:  *   ~/.pi-dashboard/   — the *managed* install dir (npm packages, etc.)
11:  *                        Older bootstrap code also wrote an *installer*
12:  *                        log to `~/.pi-dashboard/server.log` (note: same
13:  *                        filename, different dir). That file is now
14:  *                        legacy/dead in the V2 launch path.
15:  *
16:  * Loading-page recovery surfaced this on 2026-05-17: the IPC handler
17:  * read `~/.pi-dashboard/server.log` (stale installer log from May 8)
18:  * while the live server wrote to `~/.pi/dashboard/server.log`.
19:  *
20:  * All path math lives here. Every $HOME override goes through `env.homedir`
21:  * so tests can re-root without mutating `os.homedir()`.
22:  *
23:  * See change: harvest-bootstrap-survivor-fixes (cherry-pick 1).
24:  */
25: 
26: import os from "node:os";
27: import path from "node:path";
28: import { getManagedDir as getManagedDirInternal, type ManagedPathsEnv } from "./managed-paths.js";
29: 
30: /**
31:  * Shared env override surface. `homedir` mirrors `ManagedPathsEnv`; the
32:  * remaining fields are inputs to {@link resolvePiSessionsDir} only — the
33:  * other path getters ignore them.
34:  */
35: export type DashboardPathsEnv = ManagedPathsEnv & {
36:   /** `config.json#piSessionsDir` — operator's explicit dashboard override. */
37:   piSessionsDir?: string;
38:   /** Injected `process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR` (test seam). */
39:   sessionDirEnv?: string;
40:   /** Injected `process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` (test seam). */
41:   agentDirEnv?: string;
42: };
43: 
44: /** Expand a leading `~/` against `env.homedir` (or `os.homedir()`). */
45: function expandTilde(p: string, env?: DashboardPathsEnv): string {
46:   if (p === "~") return env?.homedir ?? os.homedir();
47:   if (p.startsWith("~/") || p.startsWith("~\\")) {
48:     return path.join(env?.homedir ?? os.homedir(), p.slice(2));
49:   }
50:   return p;
51: }
52: 
53: /**
54:  * Resolve the pi sessions root the dashboard scans. Precedence:
55:  *   1. `config.json#piSessionsDir`            (highest)
56:  *   2. `process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR`
57:  *   3. `process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` + `/sessions`
58:  *   4. literal `~/.pi/agent/sessions`         (last-ditch)
59:  * Each string layer is trimmed; whitespace-only is treated as unset and
60:  * falls through. Leading `~/` expands against `homedir`; absolute paths pass
61:  * through untouched.
62:  *
63:  * Layer 3 mirrors pi-core's `getSessionsDir()` (= `getAgentDir()/sessions`)
64:  * without importing the package: pi-core's published `.d.ts` barrel re-exports
65:  * via `./config.ts` specifiers that this project's `moduleResolution: bundler`
